Question: Let \(P(n)\) and \(S(n)\) denote the product and the sum, respectively, of the digits of the integer \(n.\) For example, \(P(23) = 6\) and \(S(23) = 5.\) Suppose \(N\) is a two-digit number such that \(N = P(N) + S(N).\) What is the units digit of \(N?\)
